origin.user_direction: For the present FRANK v0.1 development phase, reproducible sandbox execution is sufficient evidence; assemble the whole new Frank and omit no historical organ/module function, while allowing fusion/emergent dissolution with lineage.

merged_or_landed_engineering_deltas.result: Loopback admission can no longer be crossed via HTTP redirect; schemes/userinfo/response-size boundary hardened; redirect destination not contacted in adversarial sandbox test.
Ordered schema migration chain is atomic per physical SQLite materialization; pair-wide cross-file atomicity is not falsely claimed.
Materialization gate now rejects FK-invalid state; integrity_check alone is known insufficient for that class.
Reinstall uses UPSERT update rather than SQLite REPLACE, preserving row identity, lineage and monotonic probe history.
AURA Headless and AURA Analyzer are preserved as historical Swarm/agency-tools lineage, expanding the named technical inventory from 34 to 36.
Canonical operational capability refresh now requires repo/materialization truth preflight before writable DB open.

Reentry is a first-class transition contract gated by receiver causal use, verified outcome, causal credit, exact epoch/provenance, episode/signal identity and matching causal identity; controls are no-op and reentry never grants effect authority.
Exactly 74 measured historical service/module slots are conserved. Named technical ancestry binds dynamically; unresolved slots are opaque/non-deletable and hold Whole Frank completion.

negative_results_preserved.finding: Validating only the starting loopback URL did not prevent urllib redirect follow to a non-loopback destination.
INSERT OR REPLACE recreated all legacy-module rows on reinstall while the explicit DELETE trigger test still passed.
Outer rollback after per-file executescript was not sufficient evidence for all-or-nothing ordered migration chains.
Measured historical service/module aggregate is 74, but only 36 current technical identities are named from available ancestry; 38 remain unresolved and must not receive invented functions.
Two surviving sources disagree on variable count; no silent resolution.

parallel_worker_integration.principle: Fresh main deltas are treated as new evidence and composed rather than overwritten.
examples: Atomic schema migration and FK validity landed from parallel workers while this worker was testing.
AURA/Swarm lineage expanded the technical inventory from 34 to 36 and immediately superseded the earlier crosswalk count.
Causal reentry became first-class while the 74-slot gate was being integrated; the final CI composition retains both.

blocking_items: Resolve or primary-source the remaining 38 historical service/module identities against the measured 74 aggregate.
Run a real Qwen-class 4B inference through the hardened local engine-neutral boundary; current integrated monolith uses a mock model boundary.
Port/execute the passing reference semantics in the final compiled Clay binary path rather than Python-only reference runtime.
Continue matched lesion/rescue coverage for historical organ functions beyond the current ACC/reentry/topology and mechanism-dynamics subset.
Reconcile still-useful older repo-first Harness/Hyperposition and H1 causal replay candidates onto advancing main without reintroducing stale boundaries.

feedback.frank: Keep the current single-module/single-authoritative-DB direction. Whole Frank must remain HOLD while any measured historical module slot lacks primary identity/function mapping.
feedback.harness: Use the integrated monolith as a semantic oracle, but preserve both cognitive-organ and technical-service conservation namespaces plus 74-slot HOLD. Add matched lesions/rescues rather than invocation-only coverage.
feedback.unifieddb: Keep authority singular, migrations atomic per physical DB and fail closed on FK/materialization divergence. Final single-DB target removes the transitional cross-file crash-atomicity problem rather than pretending it is solved by two DBs.
feedback.claygraph: Remain reconstructable/diagnostic in the final target rather than a competing runtime truth store. Graph-shaped projections must not gain effect authority.
feedback.claycode: Compile the causal reentry, effect authority, organ-lineage and 74-slot completeness contracts into the final single-module binary path before claiming final runtime equivalence.
feedback.gwt: Treat ignition/broadcast as incomplete without receiver causal use, verified outcome and exact reentry lineage. Preserve overcoupling tripwires.
feedback.hyperposition: Non-selected alternatives remain preserved. Selection and reentry must not erase branches or expand authority.
feedback.emergenz: Module collapse is not emergence evidence. Continue lesion/rescue, shuffled/no-reentry controls, recurrence and cross-context tests; no phenomenal-consciousness inference.
feedback.clayresearch: Propagate the new 36/74 technical inventory and HOLD semantics to all workers; supersede earlier 34-count assumptions without erasing their provenance.
feedback.clay: Parallel work is currently productive; continue composing fresh main deltas under sandbox tests and never overwrite a newer invariant with an older branch.
